name: LoyaltyDiscountRequired
doc:
Members of the loyalty scheme must receive
a minimum 10% discount on every order.

name: MinimumOrderSize
doc: Orders must contain at least one item.

name: MaximumOrderSize
doc:
Orders must contain no more than 10 items
to avoid barista overload.

name: veganMilkDrinkRule
doc:
Any drink marked as vegan must not use
dairy milk — only oat, soy, or almond.

name: BaristaMinimumHours
doc:
Staff members in the barista role must be
contracted for at least 12 hours per week.

name: MenuItem
doc:
Something the shop sells. Describes intrinsic product
characteristics only. Price and availability are
business decisions that live on CatalogueEntry.

name: Drink
doc: A drink, extending MenuItem with drink-specific attributes

name: CatalogueEntry
doc:
The business decision to offer an item for sale.
Specialises the General CatalogueEntry (S518, S0.3):
references an item definition (MenuItem or specialisation)
and adds typed business-context properties: price,
availability, provision kind. A single item may appear in
multiple catalogues at differe

name: InventoryRecord
doc:
A point-in-time record of stock level for a catalogue
item. References a catalogue entry (not the item
definition directly) because inventory is scoped to
what the business currently offers.

name: Person
doc: A person who interacts with the coffee shop

name: Customer
doc: Someone who buys from the shop

name: StaffMember
doc: Someone who works in the shop

name: OrderLine
doc:
A single line on an order - one item with its quantity.
A line may name who it is for (H-0486): a free-text
beneficiary label, with an optional contact reference.
Both are optional; most lines carry neither.

userFacing.shortDescription: One item asked for on an order, with its quantity and its own preparation status.

purposiveDescription.description: One item on a customer order, with its quantity and, optionally, who it is for. Each line is prepared and collected on its own, so it carries its own preparation status: queued, in preparation, ready, collected, or cancelled if its order is cancelled. A line cannot start preparation until its order is paid.

attrs.mappingNotes: An order line is a record of one item asked for on an order: information content, part of the order's record. The preparation of the item is a process in the fulfilment workflow; the line's preparation axis records where that process has reached.

name: Order
doc:
A customer order, containing one or more order lines.
The participant placing the order (orderingParty) and the
service subject are carried as separate fields, both typed
by the General defs. For a walk-in Cafe the two coincide;
both are carried so that surface work generalises (H-0630).

userFacing.shortDescription: A customer's order of one or more items, with its lifecycle and payment status.

purposiveDescription.description: What a customer asked for, as one or more order lines. An order carries two independent statuses. Its lifecycle runs from placed through in preparation and ready to collected, and follows its lines: it is never moved to ready or collected directly. It can be cancelled at the counter before it is ready. Its payment runs from unpaid to paid, taken at the till.
